findings.why_below_standard: V2 treated the forecast cutoff and every outcome field as one window beginning at the cutoff. Full-year flows, year-end balances and post-cutoff events are different economic measurements.
findings.economic_impact: A partial-year interpretation could reverse volume, margin, cash or working-capital direction and train the investor on the wrong operating period.
missing_facts: raw numerator and denominator identities for derived fields
findings.prohibited_assumption: The forecast cutoff is also the accounting measurement-period start.
findings.remediation: Freeze V3 atomic clocks and complete raw-field formulas before any source is opened.
findings.acceptance_criteria: All 14 cells validate under V3 and include exactly one FLOW_PERIOD, BALANCE_AS_OF or EVENT_WINDOW clock; derived fields bind raw inputs, units, conversions and full formulas.

findings.why_below_standard: V2 named a custodian but did not project a value-free source/field package through the accepted acquisition and settlement adapter APIs.
findings.economic_impact: A custodian could see forecast content or return an unpaged, wrong-boundary value that looks mechanically settled, contaminating enterprise-learning evidence.
missing_facts: PDF page and raw field identity
boundary, unit and raw value binding
findings.prohibited_assumption: Naming OUTCOME_ONLY access is equivalent to a value-free custody submission contract.
findings.remediation: Use outcome_measurement_acquisition.build_value_free_custody_projection and keep future settlement delegated to outcome_measurement_settlement_adapter.register_acquisition_result.
findings.acceptance_criteria: The projection contains all 14 atomic contracts and no J2/J3 hypotheses, forecast direction/value or probabilities; UNKNOWN events create no negative observation receipt.

findings.why_below_standard: V2 recomputed selection from caller-supplied roster and receipt payloads rather than resolving immutable identities from the shared canonical control plane.
findings.economic_impact: A substituted completion receipt or reordered roster could choose an easier company transition and create selection bias in the learned method.
findings.prohibited_assumption: A JSON object supplied at call time is the same object that was formally registered.
findings.remediation: Register the formal roster and receipts once; production selection accepts only canonical IDs and resolves rank 18 from shared storage.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Unknown receipt IDs and inline roster payloads fail; registered formal IDs reproduce CN:600802 rank 18.
